type FilterRowProps = { label: string; on?: boolean } import React from "react" import { cn } from "@heroui/react" import { CheckCircleIcon, StarIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react" /** One course in the preview list (marketing illustration, not real data). */ interface PreviewCourse { initial: string name: string level: string rating: string price: string tone: "accent" | "success" | "warning" } const COURSES: ReadonlyArray = [ { initial: "FS", name: "Fullstack Mastery", level: "Intermediate", rating: "4.9", price: "1.290k", tone: "accent" }, { initial: "SD", name: "System Design", level: "Advanced", rating: "5.0", price: "1.490k", tone: "success" }, { initial: "DO", name: "DevOps Mastery", level: "Advanced", rating: "4.8", price: "1.390k", tone: "warning" }, ] const TONE_TILE: Record = { accent: "bg-accent-soft text-accent-soft-foreground", success: "bg-success-soft text-success-soft-foreground", warning: "bg-warning-soft text-warning-soft-foreground", } /** One filter row with a tick box (checked = accent). */ const FilterRow = ({ label, on }: FilterRowProps) => ( {on ? : null} {label} ) /** * A one-page website preview (course-catalog style) ΓÇö header nav + filter sidebar + course * list with rating/price. Token-aware (`bg-surface`/`border-default`/`text-foreground`ΓÇª) so it * reads well in both light and dark. Fills the parent's height (used in `ShowcaseMockup aspect="video"`). * The content is a marketing illustration, not real data. */ export const SitePreview = () => (
{/* app nav */}
StarCi Courses Roadmap Pricing
Sign up
{/* body: filter sidebar + course list */}
Topic
Format
{COURSES.map((course) => (
{course.initial}
{course.name} {course.rating} ┬╖ {course.level}
{course.price} / course
))}
)
